description: Bifrost gateway chat completions, a tool call then its answer, traced by the gateway's otel plugin.
notes: The pinned bifrost-http binary runs as a subprocess with the otel plugin (trace_type genai_extension, HTTP protobuf to the receiver). The config keeps the three air-gap keys: file:// pricing and model parameters from the committed vendor datasheet (so the reported cost is stable) and mcp_library_sync_interval 0, plus client.enforce_auth_on_inference false. The provider's base_url is the mock; the two GET /v1/models probes at start are answered by the mock without a turn. Two requests reach the upstream as gpt-4o-mini: one with a get_weather tool, then the same conversation with the assistant's tool call and the tool result. Each request is a /v1/chat/completions SERVER root and a chat CLIENT span; span_names keeps those two names and drops the 24 plugin.* spans per request. The root repeats its chat child's model and content and has no gen_ai.operation.name; its tool-call messages flatten the call (name and args, no function object). bifrost.request.id and bifrost.selected_key.id are UUIDs, and the three duration attributes are measured.
